replies.if_they_say: How much does a chatbot cost?
replies.reply: Setup is INR 2,999 or INR 4,999 depending on how many questions and flows you need, plus INR 299/month for maintenance. You only pay after you test and approve the work. Quick question: what are the 2 or 3 questions customers ask you most often?

replies.if_they_say: Will it sound robotic to my customers?
replies.reply: No, we write custom instructions using everyday language and your specific tone, so it feels like a polite staff member rather than an automated IVR menu. What kind of business do you run?

replies.if_they_say: Do you set this up for my kind of business?
replies.reply: Yes, it works for any business that gets repeated questions about timings, pricing, or bookings. Tell me what service or product you offer, and I will tell you honestly whether a bot is worth it for you.
